title: Eklutna Lake Adventure Sampler
includes: Safety related equipment: live jackets, helmets, etc
Eklutna Lake is outside of cell phone coverage, and we do not have electricity to provide Wifi (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Participation waiver signature required from all guests before the activity starts
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The turquoise waters of Eklutna Lake, fed by Eklutna Glacier, are surrounded by towering peaks and a rich forest ecosystem. Make the most of your time at Eklutna Lake by choosing two of the following guided outdoor adventures: biking, hiking, or kayaking. 

We'll take you beyond the basics of the valley's flora and fauna. You'll get a history of the valley, it's use as Anchorage's water source, the Alaska natives that have called the valley home, and their fight to protect and restore their ancestral lands.
